content:
Talia (product): Small follow-up from design crit: Compliance row still has a few accessibility + copy nits before we ship. Main items: retention blurb wraps in compact rows, region placeholder reads blank in some locales, KMS badge labels ambiguous, and export CTA needs to make it clear it respects filters.
Ethan (design): Proposed single-line fixes: "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more." for retention; region fallback -> "All regions"; badges -> 'Redwood-managed key' and 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. For export: "Export filtered logs (CSV)". I also reduced badge saturation so it doesn't compete with the region control.
Marco (eng): Backend supports `format=csv|json`. I'll set CSV default client-side and swap DOM order so tab sequence is region -> retention -> badges -> actions. Low effort.
June (a11y): Ensure tooltip for BYOK is keyboard-focusable, has role="tooltip" and `aria-describedby` on the pill. Export must trigger a polite live region announcement like "Export starting (CSV)".
Asha (legal): Copy looks OK. Confirm "Learn more" links to retention policy that includes exceptions. Avoid wording suggesting retention is editable unless feature GA.
notif-bot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/imaginary/compliance-compact-v9 (view-only)
Talia (product): Thanks — @Marco please paste PR when ready and @June please run a quick SR check after merge. :thumbsup:
